chunks: "No one purchases an animal except that it says: 'O Allah, make him merciful to me.'"

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.اللَّهُمَّ: O Allah; a direct invocation and du'a
key_terms.دَابَّةً: a riding animal or beast owned and used by a person
key_terms.رَحِيمًا: merciful and compassionate in one's treatment

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about showing mercy to animals?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that animals are among the creatures toward whom humans bear moral responsibility. The hadith emphasizes mercy and kind treatment toward animals, presenting their condition as something that calls for compassion before Allah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2478 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"No one purchases an animal except that it says: 'O Allah (swt), make him merciful to me.'"
